import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_0.csv"
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_1.csv"
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_2.csv"
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_3.csv"
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_4.csv"

    # Output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_0 = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)
    df_1 = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)
    df_2 = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)
    df_3 = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)
    df_4 = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)

    # Inspect and clean columns if any unnamed columns exist (drop them)
    for df in [df_0, df_1, df_2, df_3, df_4]:
        unnamed_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("Unnamed")]
        if unnamed_cols:
            df.drop(columns=unnamed_cols, inplace=True)

    # The main large table is df_2, which contains most columns except the Id<name> columns for:
    # Intervencion, Deteccion, Actividad, Causa
    # We will map these columns to their respective Id columns by joining with the source tables 0,1,3,4.

    # Join df_2 with df_0 on 'Intervencion' to get 'IdInterv'
    # df_0: ['IdInterv', 'Intervencion']
    # df_2: has 'Intervencion' column
    df = pd.merge(df_2, df_0, on='Intervencion', how='left')

    # Join df with df_1 on 'Deteccion' to get 'IdDeteccion'
    # df_1: ['IdDeteccion', 'Deteccion']
    df = pd.merge(df, df_1, on='Deteccion', how='left')

    # Join df with df_3 on 'Actividad' to get 'IdActividad'
    # df_3: ['IdActividad', 'Actividad']
    df = pd.merge(df, df_3, on='Actividad', how='left')

    # Join df with df_4 on 'Causa' to get 'IdCausa'
    # df_4: ['IdCausa', 'Causa']
    df = pd.merge(df, df_4, on='Causa', how='left')

    # Now, reorder and select columns to match the target schema exactly:
    # Target Schema:
    # ['Fecha': string, 'IdAhogado': integer, 'IdPersona': integer, 'Localidad': string, 'Provincia': string, 'CCAA': string,
    #  'Hora': string, 'Latitud_inc': float, 'Longitud_inc': float, 'Sexo': string, 'Edad': float, 'Nacionalidad': string,
    #  'Origen': string, 'Extraccion': string, 'Causa': string, 'TipoAhogamiento': string, 'Factor': string,
    #  'Intervencion': string, 'Pronostico': string, 'Localizacion': string, 'Riesgo': string, 'Reanimacion': string,
    #  'Vigilancia': string, 'Actividad': string, 'Deteccion': string, 'ID': integer, 'Estacion': string, 'Estado': string,
    #  'Latitud_est': float, 'Longitud_est': float, 'T_med': float, 'T_max': float, 'T_min': float, 'Presion': float,
    #  'Dir. vi.': float, 'V_Viento': integer, 'Nubosidad': float, 'ProfNievecm': float, 'InsolacHoras': float, 'Distancia': float,
    #  'IdActividad': integer, 'IdCausa': integer, 'IdDeteccion': integer, 'IdInterv': integer]

    # Note: Source df_2 has 'Precipitaciones' column which is not in target schema, so we drop it.

    # Ensure all columns exist in df, if any missing columns, create with NaN or appropriate dtype
    target_columns = ['Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
                      'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
                      'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
                      'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
                      'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
                      'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
                      'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv']

    # Some columns might be missing due to join issues, ensure they exist
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.NA

    # Select and reorder columns
    df_target = df[target_columns]

    # Convert dtypes according to target schema:
    # Fecha: string (keep as is)
    # IdAhogado, IdPersona, ID, IdActividad, IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdInterv: integer
    # Edad, Latitud_inc, Longitud_inc, Latitud_est, Longitud_est, T_med, T_max, T_min, Presion, Dir. vi., Nubosidad, ProfNievecm, InsolacHoras, Distancia: float
    # V_Viento: integer
    # Others: string

    # Convert integer columns (allowing for missing values)
    int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv', 'V_Viento']
    for col in int_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # Convert float columns
    float_cols = ['Edad', 'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
                  'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']
    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # Convert all other columns to string, fill NaN with empty string or keep as is
    str_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in int_cols + float_cols + ['Fecha']]
    for col in str_cols:
        df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype('string')

    # Fecha column: ensure string type
    df_target['Fecha'] = df_target['Fecha'].astype('string')

    # Write to CSV without index
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
